canonical_project: Government of Samoa Data Center (Digitally Connected and Resilient Samoa Project, DCRSP P180807)
owner: Government of Samoa / MCIT and OOTR (executed via Ministry of Finance); World Bank grant US$20m
notes: DCRSP Component 1 includes 'upgrade and establishment of secure and resilient government data center' plus national fibre and Government Intranet enhancement (MCIT official page). World Bank ISR indicators (data-centre capacity, renewable energy consumed in government data center) still show 0 current progress in 2026 snapshots with targets to Oct 2029; no procurement/completion record found, so status stays planned/implementation-stage. Site not officially disclosed - likely Tuamasaga (Apia) but that is inference; no capacity assigned.
